{{Quote|You ordered the cream of fleek eel, right? Careful, hun, the plate's hot. And the fleek eels bite.|[[FLO/Legends|FLO]] serving cream of fleek eel soup to a customer|<ref name="New Essential Guide to Droids">''[[The New Essential Guide to Droids]]''</ref>}}
'''Cream of fleek eel soup''' was a type of [[Soup/Legends|soup]] that contained live [[Fleek eel/Legends|fleek eels]],<ref name="Dining at Dex's" /> a [[Species/Legends|species]] of [[Eel/Legends|eel]] [[Homeworld/Legends|native]]<ref name="Complete Encyclopedia">{{CSWECite|I|280|fleek eel}}</ref>the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="Atlas">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> [[Falleen/Legends|Falleen]].<ref name="Complete Encyclopedia" /> The soup was sold for 1.7 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] per cup or 2.7 credits per bowl at [[Dex's Diner/Legends|Dex's Diner]]<ref name="Dining at Dex's" /> on the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] planet<ref name="Atlas"/> [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. The diner's menu promised that a cup would contain at least four eels and a bowl would contain at least eight. Each eel would be liberally coated in [[pepper oil]] and the [[Waiter/Legends|server]] would serve the hot dish with a quick shake to ensure the eels were lively. The diner claimed that its soups were as good as those made by the [[Soup People]] of [[Tureen VI]].<ref name="Dining at Dex's" />

==Behind the scenes==
Cream of fleek eel soup was first mentioned as simply "cream of fleek eel" in a quote in the [[2006]] reference book ''[[The New Essential Guide to Droids]]'' written by [[Daniel Wallace]].<ref name="New Essential Guide to Droids" /> It was identifed as a soup in "[[Dining at Dex's]]," an article written by [[Gregory Walker]] as an [[in-universe]] menu for Dex's Diner that was published on the [[Hyperspace: The Official Star Wars Fan Club|Hyperspace]] section of [[StarWars.com]] on [[December 3]], [[2009]].<ref name="Dining at Dex's" />
